decisions.reason: The black finish range sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep, and its upgrade to its own page in 2024 signals growing value, so the option stays open.

The shower channel for seamless coverings has had its own page for two consecutive years and fits the trend toward seamless, barrier-free bathrooms, so its value looks confirmed and keeping it costs little.

The pump-drain shower channel launched only in 2024 and its prospects are still uncertain, so it is worth keeping open, though the earlier pump-assisted line C was withdrawn and that is a modest warning sign.
